name: models-health-200
notes: GET /v1/models/health returns one row per catalog model with its provider's last probe result: prov-a's models are up (last probe latency 42ms, ring samples 4, uptime_1h 100), prov-b's b-model is unknown (never probed). The test additionally decodes the body and asserts the unprobed row's last_probe_at/latency_ms/uptimes are null. Probes are provider-level key tests, not per-model checks. No upstream is called: the handler reads the local catalog plus the wired health checker, so recorded_response is nominal only.
